facts.behavior: OB:T/U write independent two-byte logical map-cell type/subtype fields while retaining appearance.
Two-byte queries sign-extend their stored short.

implementation: An initializer T91 immediately followed by unconditional OB:S at the same coordinates can stage the sign identity before its native default is disabled. A monster may retain its native container only for that disabled sign case; its artwork and original subtype remain. Ordinary active monsters remain guarded combatants.
limits: No general active monster/hero/town retyping is admitted; source service conversions retain their earlier restrictions. No original campaign victory is claimed by these controls.
